lines: Some Ontario rivers take a detour
through Manitoba to reach Hudson Bay.
ontario.sourceLine: Via Lake Winnipeg and the Nelson River · International Joint Commission / Manitoba
ontario.note: Some Ontario rivers take a detour through Manitoba before reaching Hudson Bay.
ontario.receivingNote: The Great Lakes count as destinations here. Northern rivers are traced to their ocean outlet, even when their journey leaves Ontario.

sources.title: International Joint Commission — Lake of the Woods and Rainy River
